author: monserrath922

title: Incredible adventure
text: It was an amazing pedal in Sierra Nevada, Granada! The route was challenging, but with breathtaking landscapes. It was my first time using a mountain bike and I confess I was a little insecure at first, but Julio passed all the necessary confidence and explained everything with a lot of patience. During the pedal, he took care of every detail, including recording everything with amazing photos and videos, which made the experience even more special. I recommend closed-eyed for those who want to live an authentic and well-organized adventure amidst the nature of Granada, Andalusia.
author: Go04321120886
